title: SignalPhaseChanged
description: A signal group at an intersection transitioned between phases. Emitted by the controller on every transition, including transitions the plan did not schedule.

asset_ref.description: The signal or controller that changed phase.

intersection_id.description: Intersection the signal group belongs to.

approach.description: Cardinal approach to the intersection. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

phase_from.description: Phase before the transition. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

phase_to.description: Phase after the transition. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

dwell_ms.description: Time held in `phase_from` before the transition, milliseconds.

plan_id.description: Timing plan in force. Absent when the controller is running fallback.

actuated.description: True if the transition was demand-actuated rather than fixed-time.

provenance.description: How the fact was produced. Required on every event.
